question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_comp_index
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018', '10-2018', '11-2018', '12-2018', '01-2019', '02-2019', '03-2019', '04-2019', '05-2019', '06-2019', '07-2019', '08-2019')
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_comp_index,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_comp_index DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_interest AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, avg_comp_index
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
top_with_name AS (
    SELECT ti.month_year, ti.interest_id, ti.avg_comp_index, im.interest_name
    FROM top_interest ti
    JOIN interest_map im ON ti.interest_id = im.id
),
rolling AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_comp_index,
        interest_name,
        AVG(avg_comp_index) OVER (
            ORDER BY 
                CASE month_year 
                    WHEN '09-2018' THEN 1 
                    WHEN '10-2018' THEN 2 
                    WHEN '11-2018' THEN 3 
                    WHEN '12-2018' THEN 4 
                    WHEN '01-2019' THEN 5 
                    WHEN '02-2019' THEN 6 
                    WHEN '03-2019' THEN 7 
                    WHEN '04-2019' THEN 8 
                    WHEN '05-2019' THEN 9 
                    WHEN '06-2019' THEN 10 
                    WHEN '07-2019' THEN 11 
                    WHEN '08-2019' THEN 12 
                END
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as rolling_avg
    FROM top_with_name
)
SELECT 
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    avg_comp_index,
    rolling_avg,
    LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY 
        CASE month_year 
            WHEN '09-2018' THEN 1 
            WHEN '10-2018' THEN 2 
            WHEN '11-2018' THEN 3 
            WHEN '12-2018' THEN 4 
            WHEN '01-2019' THEN 5 
            WHEN '02-2019' THEN 6 
            WHEN '03-2019' THEN 7 
            WHEN '04-2019' THEN 8 
            WHEN '05-2019' THEN 9 
            WHEN '06-2019' THEN 10 
            WHEN '07-2019' THEN 11 
            WHEN '08-2019' THEN 12 
        END
    ) as prev_interest_name,
    LAG(avg_comp_index, 1) OVER (ORDER BY 
        CASE month_year 
            WHEN '09-2018' THEN 1 
            WHEN '10-2018' THEN 2 
            WHEN '11-2018' THEN 3 
            WHEN '12-2018' THEN 4 
            WHEN '01-2019' THEN 5 
            WHEN '02-2019' THEN 6 
            WHEN '03-2019' THEN 7 
            WHEN '04-2019' THEN 8 
            WHEN '05-2019' THEN 9 
            WHEN '06-2019' THEN 10 
            WHEN '07-2019' THEN 11 
            WHEN '08-2019' THEN 12 
        END
    ) as prev_avg_comp_index,
    LAG(interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY 
        CASE month_year 
            WHEN '09-2018' THEN 1 
            WHEN '10-2018' THEN 2 
            WHEN '11-2018' THEN 3 
            WHEN '12-2018' THEN 4 
            WHEN '01-2019' THEN 5 
            WHEN '02-2019' THEN 6 
            WHEN '03-2019' THEN 7 
            WHEN '04-2019' THEN 8 
            WHEN '05-2019' THEN 9 
            WHEN '06-2019' THEN 10 
            WHEN '07-2019' THEN 11 
            WHEN '08-2019' THEN 12 
        END
    ) as prev2_interest_name,
    LAG(avg_comp_index, 2) OVER (ORDER BY 
        CASE month_year 
            WHEN '09-2018' THEN 1 
            WHEN '10-2018' THEN 2 
            WHEN '11-2018' THEN 3 
            WHEN '12-2018' THEN 4 
            WHEN '01-2019' THEN 5 
            WHEN '02-2019' THEN 6 
            WHEN '03-2019' THEN 7 
            WHEN '04-2019' THEN 8 
            WHEN '05-2019' THEN 9 
            WHEN '06-2019' THEN 10 
            WHEN '07-2019' THEN 11 
            WHEN '08-2019' THEN 12 
        END
    ) as prev2_avg_comp_index
FROM rolling
ORDER BY 
    CASE month_year 
        WHEN '09-2018' THEN 1 
        WHEN '10-2018' THEN 2 
        WHEN '11-2018' THEN 3 
        WHEN '12-2018' THEN 4 
        WHEN '01-2019' THEN 5 
        WHEN '02-2019' THEN 6 
        WHEN '03-2019' THEN 7 
        WHEN '04-2019' THEN 8 
        WHEN '05-2019' THEN 9 
        WHEN '06-2019' THEN 10 
        WHEN '07-2019' THEN 11 
        WHEN '08-2019' THEN 12 
    END
